notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{晴|は}れ is the standard word for clear weather in forecasts and in everyday conversation. As a forecast term it is combined with other conditions in a fixed order:
- {晴|は}れ⟦のち→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦{曇|くも}り→曇り：02875_kumori⟧: sunny, later cloudy
- {晴|は}れ⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧⟦{曇|くも}り→曇り：02875_kumori⟧: sunny with occasional clouds
- {晴|は}れ⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: sunny with brief rain

のち marks what follows, {時々|ときどき} a condition recurring through the day, and {一時|いちじ} a single short spell.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{晴|は}れ{着|ぎ}→晴れ着：12995_haregi⟧: formal or best clothes
- {晴|は}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧: a grand occasion, a moment in the spotlight

These preserve an older sense of {晴|は}れ meaning 'formal, public, ceremonial' — the opposite of ordinary everyday life. A learner meets this sense only in set phrases; the weather sense is the live one.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧: the verb, to clear up
- ⟦{快晴|かいせい}→快晴：00137_kaisei⟧: perfectly clear, stronger than {晴|は}れ and mostly written
- ⟦{曇|くも}り→曇り：02875_kumori⟧: cloudy, the opposite condition
